cues.initial: Night over a frozen plain; far off, the low block of a facility glows cold blue in the ice, an aurora moving over it.
cues.action: A slow aerial push toward the facility; on bar 1 the title fades up, letter-spaced: HARVEST NOW, DECRYPT LATER, and NEAD beneath it.
cues.result: The facility in the ice under the aurora, the title over it.
cues.motif: the archive, seen from outside

cues.initial: Ink-blue dark, close on a single glass padlock hanging in space, lit green from inside; the camera's own glass is clear.
cues.action: The camera drifts around the lock; frost crystals grow in from the frame's edges on each downbeat; on bar 1 the lock's light breathes up and a green ring runs off it.
cues.result: A glowing green glass padlock at centre, frost dendrites reaching in from the corners of the frame.
cues.motif: planted: one small green padlock, closed, glowing

cues.initial: Close over a cream envelope lying face down in a pool of cold light; its flap open; a drop of red sealing wax pooling on the flap's tip.
cues.action: A brass seal stamp with a padlock sigil descends into the frame and presses into the wax on bar 4; wax squeezes out at the rim, the stamp lifts.
cues.result: The envelope's flap sealed with a round red wax seal bearing a padlock sigil, glistening; the paper lit cold blue from one side.
cues.motif: the love letter sealed under the padlock sigil

cues.lyric: You sent it on a Tuesday, twenty twenty-one
cues.initial: The sealed envelope with its red wax padlock seal, close.
cues.action: The camera pulls back and tilts as a postmark stamp slams onto the corner on 'Tuesday,': rings and the date "TUE 2021-03-09" in blue ink.
cues.result: The whole envelope on the dark table: red wax seal at the flap, the postmark "TUE 2021-03-09" at the corner, cold light raking across the paper.
cues.motif: the Tuesday letter, sealed and dated

cues.lyric: A little green padlock said the hard part was done
cues.initial: Macro on the wax seal's padlock: a small glass padlock set in the seal, dark.
cues.action: On 'padlock' the lock clicks shut and lights from inside, bright green; a ring of green light runs out across the wax; frost glints at the frame edge.
cues.result: Extreme close-up of a glowing green glass padlock, shallow focus, red wax around it falling out of focus.
cues.motif: the padlock clicks green: sealed, safe

cues.lyric: I couldn’t read a word of it, I didn’t even try
cues.initial: The glowing cyan fibre across the upper third; the stamped, green-locked envelope arriving under the prism tap.
cues.action: The envelope slides under the tap; a scan line sweeps its face; on 'read' the reader panel fills with churning hex that never resolves.
cues.result: The envelope under the prism, its green padlock lit; the reader panel full of churning hex.
cues.motif: the padlock holds: the tap sees only ciphertext

cues.lyric: I made myself a copy and I put it on ice
cues.initial: The envelope under the prism tap, the reader churning hex; the frost-lined chute below empty.
cues.action: On 'copy' a translucent ghost of the envelope peels downward off the original (the original hops on along the fibre, untouched). The copy tips into the chute and falls; on 'ice' it hits the chute's floor at the bottom of the frame and frost blooms up the chute walls in a burst of branching white dendrites.
cues.result: The original green-locked envelope riding off to the right along the fibre; below the tap the chute's walls thickly furred with frost, the pale copy lying in it, its padlock a frosted, colourless twin.
cues.motif: the copy's padlock is a pale, frosted twin of the green one

cues.lyric: I don’t have to break you
cues.initial: Darkness in a cold room: one steel rack of small drawers lit by a single cold-blue strip light, the rest lost in fog; low mist on the floor. Drawer 0001, at eye level, stands open; the frosted copy of the Tuesday envelope slides down into it.
cues.action: The camera glides close past the open drawer. On 'break' a cold glint runs across the frosted padlock on the envelope (a single bright specular streak), the lock untouched and whole.
cues.result: Close on drawer 0001: inside, the pale envelope lies flat, its frosted padlock catching one bright glint; the drawer's frosted glass front and steel frame fill the right half; fog and darkness behind.
cues.motif: the frosted padlock filed in drawer 0001, glinting, unbroken

cues.lyric: I only have to keep you
cues.initial: Drawer 0001 open with the frosted envelope inside; one rack lit, fog around it.
cues.action: The camera pulls back a step. On 'keep' the drawer slides shut with a small settle, frost creeps across its glass front, and its mono tag prints "0001 · TUE 2021-03-09" while its status lamp turns on pale. Behind it more racks fade up out of the fog, one by one.
cues.result: A shut drawer with a frosted glass front and a lit mono tag "0001 · TUE 2021-03-09" in the right of frame; behind, a short aisle of steel racks faintly lit in cold blue, fading into fog; low floor mist.
cues.motif: drawer 0001 shut on the frosted padlock: kept

cues.lyric: I’ll wait for you, I’ve got the time
cues.initial: The full aisle in amber: two tall walls of drawers receding into fog toward a vanishing point at centre, frost on every glass front with an amber status lamp behind each, cold strip lights overhead; many drawers stand open.
cues.action: Two rack-end counters frame the aisle mouth, rolling up from 00124; the camera dollies past them into the aisle a step per bar. On 'time' a wave of drawers slams shut from the camera toward the vanishing point, each lamp flicking amber as it closes; the counters (now behind the camera) roll to 00412.
cues.result: A deep symmetrical aisle of shut, frosted drawers, hundreds of small amber lamps glowing behind frost on both walls, cold strip lights overhead; fog at the far end.
cues.motif: hundreds of frosted padlocks fill the aisle

cues.lyric: Every byte you ever sent is mine
cues.initial: Looking straight down a vast round shaft lined with thousands of frosted drawers, gold lamps ringing it level below level into blue fog.
cues.action: Sealed envelopes pour in from the rim and spiral down the shaft in a vortex, faster on every beat; on 'mine' every lamp in the shaft flares gold at once, ring after ring downward.
cues.result: The shaft from above: a spiral of falling envelopes funnelling into the deep, rings of gold lamps glowing down to the fog.
cues.motif: every envelope falls into the archive

cues.lyric: I’ll see you sooner or later
cues.initial: Back in the amber aisle, the camera moving toward the end of one rack.
cues.action: The camera swings round the end of a rack to face its end panel, where a large mono drawer counter spins; on 'later' it stops on "08811" and the camera settles.
cues.result: The steel end panel of a rack filling the left half of the frame, a mono counter "08811" in amber on it; to the right the aisle recedes into fog, amber lamps behind frost.
cues.motif: five figures of frosted padlocks

cues.initial: The amber aisle, the camera swinging toward a rack end.
cues.action: The rack-end counter spins and stops.
cues.result: The counter on the rack end in five figures.
cues.motif: five figures of frosted padlocks

cues.lyric: Harvest now, decrypt later
cues.initial: Warm black, a sheet of frosted glass filling the frame, lit gold from behind.
cues.action: The words are stamped into the frost as they are sung, each letter a clear cut through the ice with gold light blazing through; HARVEST and LATER land hardest, shaking frost dust loose.
cues.result: "HARVEST NOW, DECRYPT LATER" cut through a wall of frost, gold light pouring through the letters, ice dust hanging in the beams.
cues.motif: the collector's creed, cut through the ice

cues.initial: Close on one frosted drawer front, its amber lamp behind the glass; a small gauge readout "0.1 PB · one Tuesday" beside it.
cues.action: On bar 27 the camera starts a powers-of-ten pull back: the drawer becomes a rack, the readout rolling up as it goes.
cues.result: One rack of glowing drawers in the dark, the readout "0.1 PB".
cues.motif: the archive measured: one Tuesday

cues.initial: One rack in the dark.
cues.action: On bar 29 the pull back continues: the rack becomes a hall of racks under strip lights; the reading rolls to 4.7 PB, "one company".
cues.result: A hall of racks from above, amber lamps in rows; reading "4.7 PB · one company".
cues.motif: the archive measured: one company

cues.initial: A hall of racks from above.
cues.action: On bar 31 the hall becomes a city block of data halls, roofs lit gold; the reading rolls to 310 PB, "one ministry".
cues.result: City blocks of glowing data halls at night; reading "310 PB · one ministry".
cues.motif: the archive measured: one ministry

cues.initial: City blocks of data halls.
cues.action: On bar 32 the view lifts to orbit: a whole continent of grids glowing gold under the blue night of the planet's limb; the reading rolls to 9,400 PB, "one continent".
cues.result: From orbit: a continent of gold grid-light curving away under the blue atmosphere; reading "9,400 PB · one continent".
cues.motif: the archive measured: one continent

cues.lyric: They’re stacking up the qubits, a few more every year
cues.initial: Under cold white work lights, a bare frame of thin rods at centre with two plain circular plates hung on it; a small square chip at the bottom with a grid of mostly dark dots; mono readouts beside it: "300 K" and "QUBITS 53".
cues.action: On each beat a new plate bolts onto the frame below the last with a small bounce, and a new row of the chip's dots lights; the qubit readout steps 53 → 127 → 433; on 'qubits,' the fifth and smallest plate bolts on and the readout lands "QUBITS 1121". The frame then turns slowly.
cues.result: A bare five-stage frame of stacked circular plates, each smaller than the one above, on thin rods at centre, unlit metal under work lights; the chip at the bottom with its grid of dots lit cyan; readouts "300 K" and "QUBITS 1121".
cues.motif: the padlocks are out of frame; the machine to open them is being built

cues.lyric: The experts said a decade, now the decade’s nearly here
cues.initial: Macro over a row of qubit chips on a dark bench, smallest at the left: four silicon dies wired with gold, each larger than the last.
cues.action: The camera tracks along the row as each chip lights its grid of qubits, the counts 53, 127, 433, 1121 printed beside them; a "Q-DAY ETA" readout counts down its years on the hats and snaps to "near" on 'decade’s'.
cues.result: Close on the largest chip, 1121 qubits lit cyan, gold bond wires shining; the readout "Q-DAY ETA near".
cues.motif: the machine to open them grows

cues.lyric: You changed all of your passwords, you think that sees you through
cues.initial: The glowing fibre across the upper third, now dense: dozens of sealed envelopes hop along it in a stream, each passing under the prism tap; below it the frost-lined chute takes a steady drop of translucent copies.
cues.action: On 'passwords,' every padlock on the envelopes riding the fibre re-keys at once: a ripple of green clicks runs left to right along the wire, each lock flashing a fresh green; the frosted copies already in the chute below stay pale and unchanged.
cues.result: Upper third: a stream of envelopes with bright green padlocks along the cyan fibre; lower half: the chute packed with pale envelopes whose frosted padlocks are colourless and unchanged.
cues.motif: new green padlocks above; the old frosted copies below do not change

cues.lyric: But a blueprint or a birthday stays as true as true
cues.initial: Darkness; two blocks of clear ice hang in a shaft of cold light, turning slowly.
cues.action: On 'blueprint' the first block catches the light: frozen inside it, the line drawing of a building's floor plan, glowing through the ice; on 'birthday' the second: a cake with candles and a date. Tags hang from both: "valid: forever".
cues.result: Two ice blocks side by side, a blueprint frozen in one, a birthday cake in the other, light refracting through them, ice dust in the beam.
cues.motif: the frosted copies keep what never expires

cues.lyric: They handed you the new math
cues.initial: Dark frame; a sparse 3D lattice of faint points joined by hairlines, rotating slowly; a small mono label in the corner "ML-KEM · FIPS 203 · 2024".
cues.action: Shells of lattice points light green outward from the origin on each beat; on 'math' the whole lattice snaps into full crystal and one short bright vector from the origin flares.
cues.result: A complete crystalline lattice of green-lit points and hairlines filling the centre, a single short bright green vector from its origin; the corner label "ML-KEM · FIPS 203 · 2024".
cues.motif: a new kind of lock, the lattice, handed over

cues.lyric: You said you’d get around to that
cues.initial: Close on the green lattice beginning to fold.
cues.action: The lattice folds down plane by plane into a plain cardboard crate; on 'that' a stamp slams onto the crate's side, "LATER" in heavy condensed capitals, and the crate slides off into the dark at the right.
cues.result: A plain cardboard crate stamped "LATER" in condensed capitals, sliding out at the right edge into darkness; the lattice gone; only the corner label remains.
cues.motif: the new lock, boxed and stamped LATER

cues.lyric: I’ll wait for you, I’ve got the time
cues.initial: Warm black. The chandelier complete at centre: five gold-plated circular plates on rods, coax lines spiralling between them, the chip at the bottom; readouts beside the plates; below, out of focus, rows of frosted drawers with their padlocks. It turns slowly; readout "50 K".
cues.action: Plates flash a rim light top to bottom on the downbeats; on 'time' the temperature readout drops to "4 K" and frost creeps a little up the lowest plate's rods.
cues.result: The gold chandelier at centre, rim-lit, turning; the readout beside it "4 K"; the blurred frosted drawers below.
cues.motif: the frosted padlocks wait under the chandelier

cues.lyric: Every byte you ever sent is mine
cues.initial: Looking down the round shaft of drawers, now frosted white, gold lamps far below.
cues.action: The camera falls down the shaft past ring after ring of frosted drawers, envelopes falling with it; on 'mine' the deep glows gold.
cues.result: Deep in the shaft: frosted rings of drawers rushing past, the gold glow below.
cues.motif: every byte falls into the cold

cues.lyric: I’ll see you sooner or later
cues.initial: The gold chandelier above, the frosted drawers below in focus.
cues.action: The camera settles low on the drawers under the hanging machine; on 'later' the readout drops to "100 mK".
cues.result: Frosted drawer fronts with pale padlocks in focus in the lower half; the gold chandelier hanging above them, blurred; readout "100 mK".
cues.motif: the frosted padlocks, close, under the machine

cues.initial: The drawers under the hanging chandelier.
cues.action: The readout drops as the camera settles low on the drawers.
cues.result: Frosted drawers under the gold machine.
cues.motif: the frosted padlocks, under the machine

cues.lyric: Harvest now, decrypt later
cues.initial: Macro on a frosted glass padlock behind ice, gold light from above.
cues.action: Frost thickens across the lock; on 'decrypt' a crack runs through it with a bright tick of gold light from inside.
cues.result: A frosted padlock with a bright hairline crack across its body, gold light leaking out of it.
cues.motif: first crack: a hairline across one frosted padlock

cues.initial: The full chandelier at centre, all five gold plates lit, turning; the cracked padlock below.
cues.action: The chandelier hums alone; on each downbeat one plate dims to black, top to bottom; on bar 56 the last plate and the chip go dark.
cues.result: A near-black frame: the chandelier only a faint silhouette of plates and rods, its readout "20 mK" the last thing lit.
cues.motif: the cracked padlock in the dark below

cues.initial: Flat paper-white daylight: a kanban board seen straight on, column headers "Q3 2022", "Q4 2022", "Q1 2023" across the top, the columns empty.
cues.action: On bar 57 the board snaps into place with a small settle, ruled column lines drawing down.
cues.result: An empty daylight kanban board, quarter headers along the top, thin grey column rules, no cards yet.
cues.motif: the defenders' office; no padlock

cues.lyric: Ticket opened, priority low
cues.initial: The empty daylight board, column "Q3 2022" at the left.
cues.action: A large ticket card drops into the Q3 2022 column on 'opened,' and its fields fill in: "PQC-114 · Migrate key exchange to post-quantum", an assignee circle, a crate icon as attachment; on 'low' a red "LOW" chip stamps onto the card.
cues.result: One big white card in the Q3 2022 column: "PQC-114", "Migrate key exchange to post-quantum", a grey assignee circle, a small crate icon stamped LATER, and a red "LOW" chip.
cues.motif: the boxed lattice is the ticket's attachment

cues.lyric: Pushed to next quarter, four years in a row
cues.initial: The PQC-114 card in the Q3 2022 column.
cues.action: The card is shoved one column right on every half-beat with a small paper skid, the quarter headers sliding past behind it (Q4 2022, Q1 2023 … Q2 2026); a "Moved" counter on the card ticks up; on 'row' it lands in "Q3 2026" reading "Moved 16×".
cues.result: The card, slightly askew from its last skid, under the header "Q3 2026"; a small counter on it "Moved 16×"; the red LOW chip and crate icon still on it.
cues.motif: the lattice crate pushed quarter after quarter

cues.lyric: Somebody asked, “Who’d even store it?”
cues.initial: Close on the empty space under the PQC-114 card.
cues.action: A comment box opens under the card, a small avatar circle at its left, and types itself: "who'd even store it?"; on 'store' a thumbs-up reaction pops on with the count 3.
cues.result: Close on the comment: "who'd even store it?" with a thumbs-up and "3", in flat daylight.
cues.motif: the defenders doubt the archive exists

cues.lyric: Petabytes, darling. I adore it.
cues.initial: From orbit at night: the archive's gold grid across a continent.
cues.action: On 'Petabytes,' the camera pulls further back: the whole night side of the planet glows with archive grids, gold veins across every landmass, the blue atmosphere a thin line.
cues.result: The night side of the earth, every continent veined with gold grid-light; a mono tag "31,000 PB".
cues.motif: a planet of frosted padlocks

cues.lyric: I waited for you, I had the time
cues.initial: The gold chandelier at centre, turning, frost on its outer rods, readout "20 mK"; the chip's qubit grid partly lit.
cues.action: Qubit dots light row by row with the beats; on 'time' the readout settles at "10 mK · BASE" and every qubit on the chip is lit.
cues.result: The gold chandelier at centre, frost on its rods, every dot on the chip at the bottom lit gold; readout "10 mK · BASE".
cues.motif: the machine at base temperature above the cracked padlocks

cues.lyric: Every byte you ever sent is mine
cues.initial: Macro on the chip at the bottom of the chandelier, gold package, dark silicon.
cues.action: Qubits light row by row; gold light runs down the bond wires; on 'mine' every qubit flares gold at once.
cues.result: The chip filling the frame, every qubit blazing gold, bond wires lit, frost on the package's edges.
cues.motif: the machine at base: every qubit lit

cues.lyric: The fridge hums low, the key falls out
cues.initial: The underside of the chandelier's chip in gold light, vapour curling below.
cues.action: On 'hums' the rig shivers and the lit qubits gather into a toothed key; on 'falls' the key drops out of the chip and falls in slow motion through the cold vapour, turning, down toward a frosted drawer and its padlock.
cues.result: A gold key in mid-fall, turning through curls of vapour, a frosted padlock waiting below.
cues.motif: the key falls toward the padlocks

cues.lyric: So that’s what you were on about
cues.initial: The cold aisle in blue-black, drawers frosted, padlocks pale; at the far end a wall of warm sunrise light starts to roll toward the camera.
cues.action: The sunrise sweeps down the aisle, frost melting from every drawer front into steam; on 'about' the padlocks spring open in a chain down the aisle, shackles flipping up.
cues.result: A warm gold aisle in sunrise light, steam rising from the drawer fronts, every padlock open, small red broken seals.
cues.motif: padlocks spring open in a chain down the aisle

cues.initial: The aisle at sunrise.
cues.action: Padlocks spring open in a chain down the aisle.
cues.result: A warm gold aisle, every padlock open.
cues.motif: padlocks spring open

cues.lyric: I said sooner or later
cues.initial: Close on the Tuesday envelope in warm sunrise light, its red wax seal and the padlock sigil.
cues.action: The seal cracks and breaks in two; the flap lifts; on 'later' the letter slides out and unfolds flat: ruled lines of ink, a date in serif italic at the top.
cues.result: The opened letter in golden light, ruled ink lines and the date "Tuesday, 9 March 2021" in italic, the broken wax seal beside it.
cues.motif: the Tuesday letter opens: the plant paid off

cues.lyric: Harvested then, decrypted now
cues.initial: Drawer 0001 open in the sunrise aisle.
cues.action: On 'decrypted' every drawer in the aisle opens at once and envelopes unfold into line drawings (blueprints, cakes, ruled letters); over the long held "now" the camera rises up and over the racks, revealing a whole golden city of open drawers and unfolded pages.
cues.result: High overhead in warm sunrise light: a vast grid of open drawers and unfolded pages, red broken seals scattered across them, steam rising.
cues.motif: every padlock open, every page readable

cues.initial: From orbit: the planet at dawn, the archive grids across the continents.
cues.action: The terminator sweeps across the planet: the sun rises over the edge, the archive's gold grid lights go out one region after another as daylight reaches them; on bar 85 the sun clears the limb and floods the frame.
cues.result: The planet's limb with the sun breaking over it, a blaze of light, the grids faded into daylight.
cues.motif: the open archive in daylight

cues.lyric: Connection secure.
cues.initial: Ink-blue dark: the glass padlock glowing green, closed, intact.
cues.action: On 'secure.' the lock gives its small click, a tiny "Connection secure" tooltip opens under it; then one last thread of frost creeps in from the frame's lower-left corner.
cues.result: The glowing green padlock, "Connection secure" beneath it, a single frost thread reaching in from the corner.
cues.motif: the little green padlock again, closed, intact: telling the truth, today

cues.initial: The ocean floor at night, a single armoured cable running into the dark.
cues.action: A pulse of cyan light — the sealed letter — races along the cable past the camera on bar 7; silt drifts in the beam.
cues.result: The cable glowing as the light runs away into the deep.
cues.motif: the letter crossing the sea, sealed

cues.initial: A vast round vault door of frosted steel stands half open, cold light spilling from the archive behind it.
cues.action: The door swings shut and its bolts drive home on bar 17; frost blooms across its face, vapour rolls off it.
cues.result: The sealed door, frosted, its locking wheel still.
cues.motif: the archive sealed

cues.initial: A clock face frozen in clear ice, its hands visible through it, gold light behind.
cues.action: The second hand drags slower and slower as frost thickens; on the downbeat it stops.
cues.result: The clock stopped inside the ice: all the time in the world.
cues.motif: time held still

cues.initial: A robotic library arm on a rail between towering racks of frosted cartridges.
cues.action: The arm whips along the rail and slots a cartridge home on the downbeat; status lights ripple.
cues.result: The arm withdrawn, the cartridge seated, lights rippling down the rack.
cues.motif: filed

cues.initial: A silicon wafer under cleanroom light, hundreds of chips on it.
cues.action: The chips light their qubit grids one after another across the wafer.
cues.result: A whole wafer of lit chips: a few more every year.
cues.motif: the machine multiplied

cues.initial: A dark warehouse: shelves of identical crates to the ceiling and beyond.
cues.action: The camera pulls back from the LATER crate slid onto a shelf, back and up until it is one of thousands.
cues.result: An endless warehouse of crates stamped LATER.
cues.motif: the new lock, shelved

cues.initial: The ice clock again, frost thicker, the chandelier's gold light on it.
cues.action: Its hands tick once on the downbeat, and stop.
cues.result: The clock in thick ice.
cues.motif: time held still

cues.initial: The library arm between the racks, faster now.
cues.action: Cartridges slot home in a rhythm down the rack.
cues.result: Racks full, lights rippling.
cues.motif: filed

cues.initial: A desk calendar in office daylight, quarter pages.
cues.action: Pages tear away one per beat in a gust, Q3 2022 to Q2 2026.
cues.result: Pages flying, the quarter still turning.
cues.motif: the lock postponed

cues.initial: The PQC-114 card mid-shove.
cues.action: It lands in its last column, Moved 16×.
cues.result: The card in Q3 2026.
cues.motif: the lattice crate pushed

cues.initial: The facility in the ice at night from the air, the aurora overhead.
cues.action: The camera glides over its roofs: vents breathing vapour, rows of cold lights.
cues.result: The archive from outside: somebody stores it.
cues.motif: the answer to "who'd even store it"

cues.initial: The ice clock, gold light hot on it.
cues.action: The ice cracks across the face and falls away; the hands start to run again.
cues.result: The clock free of the ice, its hands sweeping.
cues.motif: time runs out

cues.initial: Macro: the gold key at the keyhole of a frosted padlock.
cues.action: The key slides in and turns; the shackle springs open in a burst of frost.
cues.result: The padlock open, the key in it, frost falling.
cues.motif: the lock opened

cues.initial: Looking up the silo of drawers from deep inside it.
cues.action: Sunlight pours down the shaft from the rim; frost melts off ring after ring, steam rising.
cues.result: The shaft flooded with warm light.
cues.motif: the thaw reaches the deep

cues.initial: The vault door, sealed, frost on its face, sun behind the camera.
cues.action: The locking wheel turns and the door swings open into the sunrise.
cues.result: The open door, golden light pouring in.
cues.motif: the archive opened

cues.initial: The facility in the ice at night under the aurora.
cues.action: The title and credit fade up.
cues.result: The end card.
cues.motif: the end
